bio.text: Pamela DeLancy was a Democratic candidate for Georgia's 10th Congressional District in the May 19, 2026 primary against Lexy Doherty, according to a March 2026 Red & Black report.
The report describes her as a registered nurse and military veteran who, by her account, served more than 35 years, including six years at the Pentagon as director of medical readiness.
DeLancy retired from the Army in 2019.

sources.title: District 10 Congressional candidate Pamela DeLancy visits Athens on campaign trail
